findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Re-derive the `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` consumer inventory via find_referencing_symbols AND a string grep of the symbol name, correct the count to FIVE, and add `src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:544-547` (close-path AC-checkbox precheck) to the enumerated deterministic consumers.

Omitted site: src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:544 `from rebar.llm.plan_review.det_operator_attested import _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` and :547 `offenders = [ln for ln in floor.unchecked_ac_lines if not _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE.match(ln)]` — a fifth `is`-identical consumer (the close-path precheck).
grep for the symbol name yields exactly five production importers/users: decide_ops.py, det_measurement_provenance.py, det_attestation_launder.py, workflow_ops.py (re-export), and _commands/txn.py.
findings.finding: The 'What makes this tractable' section enumerates a CLOSED, 'verified' set of exactly FOUR deterministic consumers of the shared compiled regex `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` (decide_ops, workflow_ops, det_attestation_launder, det_measurement_provenance), but a fifth production consumer is omitted: `src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:544` imports the same object and calls `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE.match(ln)` at line 547 in the close-path AC-checkbox precheck. The inventory of references to `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` is therefore incomplete, and the 'verified' four-consumer count is wrong.
findings.location: 'What makes this tractable' section: "All four deterministic consumers share the IDENTICAL compiled regex object — verified: decide_ops, workflow_ops, det_attestation_launder, and det_measurement_provenance each satisfy `is`..."
scenarios: src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:547 — the close-path AC-checkbox precheck: if the author later reasons from the (false) 'four consumers' inventory and does anything other than widen the single shared compiled object (e.g. hands one consumer its own recompiled pattern), the txn.py close-path precheck would silently retain the narrow pattern and reject `[non-codebase]`-tagged unchecked ACs at close time.

AC #3 names 'the close path' and 'the AC-checkbox precheck' as suites to parametrize, but the tractability inventory does not identify txn.py as the code site backing that behavior, leaving the parametrization's target site unlocated.
findings.suggested_fix: Change 'All four deterministic consumers' to five and add `src/rebar/_commands/txn.py` (the `_close`/close-path precheck calling `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE.match`) to the enumerated list; note it too satisfies `is` against the single shared object so widening still propagates with no branch change.
